preamble: Palatalization, affrication and voicing of the voiceless stop [t] to the voiced postalveolar affricate [dʒ]. In Kansa and Ioway-Otoe (Siouan), Proto-Siouan *t before *e appears as ǰ/j: *(i-)sį́·te 'tail' > Kansa sį́ǰe, Ioway-Otoe síⁿje, and *(wa-)hpé·te 'fire' > Kansa ppéǰe, Ioway-Otoe péje, while Quapaw keeps a stop (ppétte).
sources: Rankin, R. L., Carter, R. T., Jones, A. W., Koontz, J. E., Rood, D. S., & Hartmann, I. (Eds.) (2015). Comparative Siouan Dictionary. Leipzig: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology. https://csd.clld.org/
